title.rendered: Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME Sales Projected to Hit 11 Million Packs Worldwide

content.rendered:
Bushiroad Inc. (Headquarters: Nakano-ku, Tokyo; President and CEO: Takaaki Kidani) is pleased to announce that sales for the Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME are projected to surpass 11 million packs worldwide across Booster Pack "Dawn of Palpagos" and Booster Pack "Legends Awaken" by early November.

Booster Pack Dawn of Palpagos Booster Pack Legends Awaken Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1
